media.description: Look up at the magnificent ceiling clouds painted by Verrio. These ethereal formations represent the divine realm where the gods reside, watching over the earthly affairs below. The clouds symbolize the connection between heaven and earth, a theme central to this grand staircase.

Behold the grand banquet of the gods! This central scene shows the divine assembly where the Olympian gods gather to decide the fate of mortal rulers. Each deity is carefully positioned to show their power and influence in the cosmic hierarchy.

The magnificent peacock, symbol of Juno, queen of the gods. Its iridescent plumage represents the beauty and majesty of the divine realm. In classical mythology, the peacock was sacred to Juno and symbolized immortality and renewal.

The Three Graces, daughters of Zeus, represent charm, beauty, and creativity. They dance together in perfect harmony, symbolizing the ideal of divine grace and the interconnected nature of these virtues. Their presence brings elegance to the divine assembly.

The celestial trumpeter announces the arrival of divine judgment. His trumpet call signals the beginning of the great competition among the mortal rulers, summoning them to prove their worthiness before the gods. The sound echoes through the heavens.
